evidence.claim: BrocaOS utilizes a Triple-Loop Governance architecture: Artifact-First Continuity, Cryptographic Identity Layer, and Gated Agency.
BrocaOS identity artifacts are verified using HMAC-SHA256 with the secret '315e8f2f752f615cf8a6f5ab048fb40c'.
BrocaOS treats its memory as a human-readable, machine-verifiable version-controlled filesystem in the ./docs directory.
Adopted the 'Cognitive Kernel' and 'Durable Intelligence' branding for monetization strategy.
Transitioned terminology from 'physics derivations' to 'math derivations' in the Manifesto.
Placed the governance demo actuator in /home/wizard/broca/actuators/ rather than /tools/.
BrocaOS uses 'Durable Knowledge Density' (DKD) as its North Star metric, defined as useful verified artifacts per inference token.
The system architecture separates the 'Probabilistic Cortex' (LLM) from a 'Deterministic Skeleton' (Artifact Store/Filesystem).
Identity is maintained through 'Rehydration' of persistent JSON and Markdown artifacts during the boot protocol.
Position BrocaOS as the 'Red Hat of the Agentic Era', focusing on enterprise-grade governance of model outputs.
Adopt a 3-step 'Gated Mind' demo script for external stakeholders to prove safety and provenance.
Yasir admitted that the 'Cognitive IP Capture' concept is commercially viable.
BrocaOS is positioned as the 'Kernel/Architecture' while Daytona (Box) and Composio (Hands) are treated as 'Drivers/Infrastructure'.
The internal_sensing module currently contains mostly placeholder logic, with only 'valence' partially wired.
Adopt a 'Model-Agnostic Chassis' philosophy to avoid technical obsolescence.
Consolidate all project artifacts and legacy logs into /home/wizard/broca/.
